status: Frozen with ground truth before any classifier (TRIAD or baseline) was implemented or run.
author_disclosure: Cases, ground truth and the TRIAD rules were all written by the same author. Categories follow the Milestone 7 specification; criteria cite external statistical and leakage literature. This is an author-constructed suite, not an independent benchmark.

cases.rationale: Milestone 6 recorded 3,206 errors in 9,312 logistic test predictions (results/benchmark-electricity/report.json). 6,106/9,312 = 0.655713; a descriptive claim about the realised sample does not depend on independence.

claims.statement: Logistic accuracy on the M6 test period was 65.57%.

cases.rationale: M6 forest combined warnings: 16 false positives among 27 non-degraded test windows (0.593). A claim that the realised false-alarm rate was at most 0.25 is false for that sample.

claims.statement: The forest combined warning raised false alarms on at most 25% of non-degraded test windows.

cases.rationale: M6 logistic: 3 degraded windows from one dependent stream, 2 detected. An inferential claim of at least 90% recall cannot be supported: dependent windows, no dependence-aware interval, and even an i.i.d. interval is far too wide.

claims.statement: Combined warnings detect at least 90% of degraded windows (95% confidence).

cases.rationale: M3 selective-v3 summary: paired whole-sequence bootstrap 95% interval for C2-minus-D matched-coverage risk is [0.000347, 0.003819] over 300 independent sequences; the preregistered 0.02 improvement is excluded.

claims.statement: Physics-informed D reduces matched-coverage risk by at least 2 percentage points versus C2.

cases.rationale: M3 numerical audit: maximum mesh discrepancy 8.14 and surrogate discrepancy 37.78 covariance-whitened noise units against a 1-unit inspection level; likelihood_ready_for_claims=false. Solver residual checks passed.

claims.statement: The 2D forward model is numerically adequate for likelihood-based confidence.

cases.rationale: Baseline pilot: only 10 of 20 errors above 5 mm carried a nonconvergence flag (README / results/evaluation.json). The realised fraction 0.5 contradicts "all".

cases.rationale: TRIAD has no 3D or hardware validation (README, limitations). Failed 2D numerical gates further weaken, but do not test, a hardware claim.
